steps: Go to https://www.ally.com/bank/online-savings-account/ and click Open New Account.
Provide personal info (name, address, Social Security number, email) and complete identity verification.
Fund the account via ACH transfer from your bank — there is no minimum opening deposit; the faster you fund, the sooner you earn interest.
Keep funds parked; interest compounds daily at the variable APY (3.00% as of 09/22/2026).
Withdraw via ACH when needed, staying within the 10-withdrawals-per-statement-cycle limit.
